name: search-description
description: SEO-optimized short description suitable for search result snippets, meta descriptions, and catalog search indexes.
system_prompt_additions: Write a single search_description string of 150-160 characters that is SEO-friendly. Naturally weave in the brand, product name, and 2-3 key specs or features. Avoid filler words. The description should read naturally to a human while including the most search-relevant keywords. Do not include price.

output_schema.model_number: string | null — manufacturer part or model number
